server.name: legacy-dms
server.description: Legacy Document Management System for retrieving applicant documents.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search the document management system for applicant documents. Pass either the applicant's last name or the loan-file borrower ID; the response includes the resolved borrower (ID and applicant first/last names).

applicant_last_name.description: Last name of the applicant. Optional when borrower_id is given.

document_type.description: Type of document (e.g. 'tax_return', 'pay_stub', 'bank_statement'), or 'all' (default) for every type.

years.description: Number of years of documents to retrieve (default 2).

borrower_id.description: Loan-file borrower ID (e.g. '1001'). Preferred when known.

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Retrieve a full document from the document management system by ID.
